data.name: RestarterUsage
data.value:
Usage: FBC.ShellExtension.Restarter [--file <path>]... [--no-restore] [-- <program> [arguments]...]
Restarts Windows Explorer through Restart Manager and opens its folder windows and tabs again where they were.
--file <path> After Explorer stops, list the other programs that still use this file. --no-restore Do not open the windows again. -- <program> Run this while Explorer is stopped and wait for it, for example to replace the shell extension DLL.

data.name: ManagerUsage
data.value:
Usage: FBC.ShellExtension.Manager [command]
check Register this copy for Explorer if needed and bring the menu up to the template. The default. register Register this copy for Explorer, even when a newer one is registered. unregister Remove the Explorer registration. The configuration stays. uninstall Remove the Explorer registration and the ffmpeg PATH entry, before deleting a portable folder. The configuration stays. With --own (the installer's uninstall), the registration of another copy that is still there stays. backup <file> Copy the configuration to a file. restore <file> Replace the configuration with a file; the current one is backed up first. reset Replace the configuration with the template; the current one is backed up first. ffmpeg Check ffmpeg. With "install winget", "install download", "path add" or "path remove": install it or put it on the PATH.

data.name: WikiKeyHelp
data.value:
Send to Wiki.js uses what is kept here for that wiki.
An API key: the wiki's administrator makes one in Administration > API Access. It works with the rights of the group it belongs to.
Or your own token, when you sign in to the wiki with your company account: sign in to the wiki in your browser, press F12, and copy the value of jwt under Application > Cookies > the wiki's address. With it you work with your own rights, and the page history shows your name. It stops working after a while (two weeks by default); then copy a fresh one. Keep it to yourself, like a password.
